learning_outcomes.text: Students acquiring knowledge regarding the processing technology of metallic and non-metallic materials. Both conventional usual technologies and modern unconventional ones are presented. Elements of plastic and composite material elaboration are analyzed, at the current technical level.
Explaining and interpreting types of technological processes, projects, etc., associated with the field of study.

syllabus_topics: General problems of the production process in machine and apparatus construction
Technological properties of metallic and non-metallic materials
Processes and procedures for primary and secondary elaboration of ferrous and non-ferrous metallic materials, plastics, and composites
Technological principles and procedures for manufacturing metal products by casting (in temporary, permanent, pressure, vacuum, continuous molds, etc.)
Technological principles and procedures for manufacturing metal products by plastic deformation (rolling, drawing, forging, die forging, extrusion, deep drawing, etc.)
Technological principles and procedures for sheet metal processing by cutting with associated edges
Fundamental phenomena, technological principles, and procedures for manufacturing products by powder aggregation
Study of casting properties of metallic materials
Influence of forming-casting factors on cast parts in temporary molds
Influence of technological factors on the quality of parts cast in permanent molds, vacuum molds, centrifugal molds
Study of a foundry's technological itinerary. Calculation of a cupola's metal charge
Influence of technological factors during deformation on work hardening of metallic materials
Determination of technological parameters for processing by drawing, deep drawing, die forging, stamping, and rolling

assessment_methods.method: Ongoing activity (including lab activity, tests, reports)

assessment_rules: The final grade is composed of 66% from the written exam and 34% from ongoing activities. The written exam has 4 subjects, each contributing 25% to the exam grade. Students must achieve a minimum grade of 5 for each exam subject. A minimum grade of 5 is required for all evaluation criteria to pass the course.
